description.value: Miku pioneered Aburi (flame-seared) sushi in Canada when it opened in Vancouver in 2008 and has earned Michelin Guide recognition and the Wine Spectator Award of Excellence. The waterfront location at Granville Square features a full bar and lounge, a patio overlooking the harbour, a private dining room, and a full-service sushi bar showcasing Ocean Wise seafood and regional west coast ingredients. A touring cyclist arriving along the seawall would find a distinctive upscale dining experience blending traditional Japanese technique with local flavours.
